result.topic_en: Definitions and basic relations of a theta-type function W(t, ω) defined as a sum of Gaussian exponentials, its periodicity, and its relation to a two-variable series P(x, y), with a further function Q(x, y) begun but left undefined.
result.transcription:
254
1) $\Sigma e^{-\pi t(k+\omega)^2} = W(t,\omega)$ für alle ganzen Werthe von $k$
2) $W(t,\omega) = W(t, k+\omega)$
3) $W(t,\omega) = e^{-\pi t\omega\omega} \cdot P(e^{-\pi t}, e^{\pm 2\pi t\omega})$
4) $P(x,y) = e^{\frac{\log y^2}{4\log\frac{1}{x}}} W\left(\frac{\log\frac{1}{x}}{\pi}, \frac{\log y}{2\log\frac{1}{x}}\right)$
